hero.title: Find your place in Physical AI.

intro.paragraph: Help us tackle the world's biggest challenges. Whether you're an engineer, an AI researcher, a transportation expert, a business specialist, or a student looking to grow your career, Waabi is where you'll solve real problems for real vehicles on real roads—while shaping entire industries.

pioneering.title: Pioneering tomorrow, together.
pioneering.paragraph:
We wake up each day with a clear mission that goes far beyond technology—we're empowering humanity to build a better tomorrow. Our team pours their expertise into pioneering a groundbreaking approach that no one else has dared to imagine. 

This bold vision has propelled Waabi into a global force with every achievement reflecting the unwavering commitment of the Waabi team.

values.title: How we work, and work together.
values.description: Our values guide how we work to drive real-world impact, turning visionary ideas into systems that navigate highways and transform lives.

slides.title: Scientific
slides.paragraph: We embrace objectivity, act with integrity, and view leadership as what you bring to work every day.

slides.title: Curious
slides.paragraph: We ask hard questions, challenge our assumptions, and seek deeper understanding before answers.

slides.title: Diverse
slides.paragraph: We assume good intentions, encourage respectful discourse, and treat differences as essential, not optional.

slides.title: Resilient
slides.paragraph: We meet challenges with grit, creativity, and optimism – turning setbacks into breakthroughs.

slides.title: Accountable
slides.paragraph: We own our words and actions. We follow through on commitments andcommunicate changes openly.

slides.title: Safe
slides.paragraph: Safety is non-negotiable. Every decision and interaction strengthens the safety of our people, our product, and our world.

slides.title: Efficient
slides.paragraph: We work with focus and purpose, designing processes that favor reliability and efficiency over speed alone.

slides.title: Data Driven
slides.paragraph: We take calculated risks, validate with evidence, and act decisively. Data fuels conviction, conviction accelerates progress, and progress generates more data – creating a virtuous cycle of innovation.

closing.title: Fuel your career's next mile.
closing.description: Waabi is where personal growth and breakthrough innovation go hand in hand. With 5 North American offices and remote flexibility, you can learn and thrive wherever you work best.
